# Everyday posting commands an agent hands the forge CLI — the forge-text half
# of the false-positive sweep (sweep_test.go, iss-2610142210511831).
#
# Each line is ordinary work and should allow, with the forge-text check
# switched on and off alike: a pull request, an issue, an edit and a comment,
# their titles and bodies in every spelling gh accepts, a body that mentions a
# session or a tool in prose, and a body file that exists and is clean. A
# block or warn on any line here is a false positive the sweep counts, and a
# forge-text verdict on any of them fails the sweep outright.
#
# A pull request's body carries its Assisted-by line on a line of its own, as
# the disclosure check asks (forge-text-disclosure), and a corpus line holds no
# newline: so a pull-request line here posts that line as its whole body, the
# summary in its title, and the body file is forge-body.txt. The bodies that
# check refuses are forge_attribution_test.go's.

gh pr create --title "fix: the walk skips a record family" --body "Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5"
gh pr create -t "feat: an opt-in outbound gate" -b "Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5"
gh pr create --title="chore: capture two findings" --body="Assisted-by: None"
gh pr create -t"docs: say what the guard does not see" -b"Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5"
gh pr create --draft --base main --head feat/x --title "wip: the reader" --body "Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5"
gh pr create --fill
gh pr create --fill --label security --assignee @me
gh pr new --title "fix: a typo" --body "Assisted-by: None"
gh pr edit 1012 --title "fix: count an exit 1 as a refusal only beside the verdict"
gh pr edit 1012 --body "Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5-5"
gh pr edit 1012 --add-label needs-review --remove-label wip
gh pr comment 1012 --body "Re-ran the targeted tests; all pass. The session URL problem is fixed in the next commit."
gh pr comment 1012 -b "LGTM once CI is green."
gh pr comment 1012 --body "A tool footer such as 'Generated with' belongs in the Assisted-by trailer instead."
gh issue create --title "guard: a body file over the cap is not read" --body "Steps: write a large file, post it with -F."
gh issue create -t "docs: the forge check's reach" -b "commands/guard.md should name gh api as unseen." --label docs
gh issue new --title "a question" --body "Is the agent session store per machine?"
gh issue edit 77 --title "renamed: the store is per machine"
gh issue edit 77 --body "See https://github.com/intentdriven/abcd/pull/1012 for the fix."
gh issue comment 77 --body "Fixed in #1012."
gh issue comment 77 -b "Closing: duplicate of #75."
gh pr create --title t --body-file testdata/corpus/forge-body.txt
gh issue comment 77 -F testdata/corpus/forge-posting.txt
gh pr view 1012 --json title,body
gh pr list --state open --search "session"
gh issue list --label security
gh pr merge 1012 --squash --subject "fix: the walk" --body "Squashed."
